description: This Java class 'MediaIDHelper' provides utility methods for creating, parsing, and managing media IDs used in a media browsing application, specifically for categorizing and retrieving media items based on hierarchy and categories.

classes.name: MediaIDHelper
classes.description: A utility class for constructing and parsing media IDs used in media browsing.

methods.name: createMediaID
methods.description: Constructs a media ID string from a music ID and optional categories, using separators.

methods.name: createBrowseCategoryMediaID
methods.description: Creates a media ID for a specific browse category based on category type and value.

methods.name: extractMusicIDFromMediaID
methods.description: Extracts the unique music ID from a media ID string.

methods.name: getHierarchy
methods.description: Returns an array of category hierarchy components from a media ID.

methods.name: extractBrowseCategoryValueFromMediaID
methods.description: Retrieves the category value from a media ID.

methods.name: getParentMediaID
methods.description: Returns the parent media ID in the hierarchy for a given media ID.
